area: reports/content_packages/<signal_id>/runs/<run_id>/ for the two synthetic test signal ids
enumeration: Every path is listed explicitly, one per line, in the two companion manifests named below. Neither manifest contains a glob or an abbreviation; both are byte-for-byte the output of `git ls-files <dir>` and can be re-derived and diffed at any time.
classification_rule: Every one of the 7,796 paths listed in the two manifests is classified DEAD_ORPHANED. The classification is stated once rather than repeated per path because the evidence is not merely similar for each file, it is identical: one writer, one root cause, one non-consumer. The per-artifact detail that does vary - which signal id, which run id, which of the six artifact kinds - is exactly what the manifest path itself records, and the per-artifact-kind evidence is given below.

shared.purpose: None. Run-scoped artifacts written into the tracked reports/ tree by pytest processes, for two signal ids that exist only in the test suite.
shared.consumer: None. No code, workflow, test or document reads any file under either directory.
shared.evidence: scripts/generate_and_publish.py:320-321 sets PACKAGES_DIR = Path('reports/content_packages') and calls .mkdir() at import time, so any test that imports the canonical entrypoint writes run artifacts under the tracked path relative to the current working directory. src/artifacts/__init__.py documents the resulting <packages_dir>/<signal_id>/runs/<run_id>/ layout. .gitignore ignores only reports/content_packages/images/ (:27), so nothing prevents these from being staged. src/run/code_identity.py:36 already records in a comment that the pipeline 'writes into tracked files under reports/'.
shared.action: See finding F5 - the single largest integrity problem by file count: 7,796 of 8,399 tracked files, 92.8% of the repository.

signals.evidence: The id appears nowhere in src/, scripts/ or .github/. Three test modules share it, which is why this tree is larger than the other.
tests/test_run_identity.py:63 _SIGNAL_ID = 'sig-identity-test-001'. One constant in one test file owns 3,094 tracked files.

artifact_kinds.purpose_when_real: The exact configuration a run executed against - the artifact tests/strategy/test_configuration_hash_snapshot.py exists to keep honest.
